VirtualBox is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2019 to 2019.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (2).

Most recently: [server-archlinux](@/work/server-archlinux.md); [k8s-orbis-pictus](@/work/k8s-orbis-pictus.md): Playground for learning docker, kubernetes, ansible and friends.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses VirtualBox: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links VirtualBox to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
